The '''Cranan-Excarga Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that went from the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] to [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]].
